description: Fitted stone plates packed into an oval, shaken loose from a Magmashell. Nothing has ever hatched out of one.
lore: They sell best within sight of [[lore/the_waking|the meadow]], and the sellers know exactly why. Someone three days woken cannot give you their name yet but can already feel the shape of the problem, which is that in this country everything has happened already. An egg is the only thing on the stall that points the other way.

The stallholders do not lie about it. Ask outright and you will be told: no, nothing comes out, it is stone through and through, they have sawn one open. They still sell four a week. A woman on the south path has kept hers eleven years, in the ash at the edge of her hearth, turned twice a day, and when this is put to her as foolishness she agrees that it is, and turns it, and says that having a thing to do at the same hour every day is not nothing.
